summary.text: John Hoffman is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 34 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John Hoffman was born in Casper, Wyoming.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Mary's University of Minnesota in 1988 and graduated from the University of Idaho in 2014.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an executive director.
Hoffman represented Minnesota Senate District 36 from 2013 to 2023, and has represented District 34 since January 3, 2023.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he listed three campaign messages: an economy that works for Minnesotans, a safer Minnesota with thriving neighborhoods and communities, and a focus on health, wellbeing and quality of life.
In the same survey, he said that 94 percent of his bills in the most recent session were bipartisan.
